answer:
Your Games note is now a 2048 game. I tried it with arrow-key moves and the stats screen, and it opened without errors at phone and Mac widths. I didn't test swiping, the win screen or the game-over screen, so those are untested.

- **Controls:** you swipe on the phone and use the arrow keys on the Mac. Tiles slide, new ones pop in, and merged tiles pulse. These animations are switched off if the device is set to reduce motion.
- **Scores:** score and best score are kept with the game. A game in progress also survives closing the note.
- **Undo:** it takes back the last move only, and it also works after a game-over.
- **New game:** a button at the top right.
- **Win screen:** it appears when you make 2048, with "Keep going" and "New game".
- **Game-over screen:** it offers "Try again" and "Undo".
- **Stats:** the chart button shows games played, best tile and average score.
- **When a game counts:** a game is counted when it ends or when you start a new one. The stats screen says so.

I removed the starter Home and Settings screens, so the note is just the game.
